objectTypes.description: A directed route between two selected places
The user decision to request a read-only ride estimate

serviceClass.description: Requested provider product name, if the user selected one

objectTypes.description: One provider estimate for a route and vehicle category

estimatedAmount.description: Exact displayed estimate in CNY major units, otherwise null

feesComplete.description: Provider did not verify full fees

objectTypes.description: One provider read and its provenance

interfaceTypes.description: A source-resolved place. Name identifies the venue; source results may also contain entrances, sections and nearby businesses with different names. The Location Interface supports exact name filtering and source-receipt Link queries.
A route whose origin and destination Links expose source Location objects for price calculation.
A current provider price observation, linked to its inquiry request and source receipt. Amount may be null for price ranges.

amount.description: Exact displayed estimate in CNY major units, otherwise null

interfaceTypes.description: Obtain current ride prices between two named venues in a city. The estimate Action resolves Location objects, gets real provider prices and records the inquiry. It returns a RideRequest; readRideEstimates returns its verified quote. Venue coordinates suffice for an estimate; a pickup entrance is not required. Genuine unresolved venue identity returns source choices. No order or payment.

functionTypes.description: Read current place candidates for city and keywords from DiDi. DidiPlaces is the data source that maps this result into Location objects and SourceReceipt links.
Read provider prices along the Links of an existing RideRequest. For a complete named-place inquiry use the RideInquiry estimate Action; the DidiEstimates source is backed by estimateLocations.

Final read and acceptance of one RideRequest: query linked PriceEstimate objects, verify source Links and freshness, return prices, route and accepted. Use after its DidiEstimates source refresh. Optional serviceClass selects a provider product name.
Whether both selected source locations have current coordinates and provenance. Used by route Action submission criteria.

Read provider prices between two current Location references. requestId identifies the inquiry whose data source projection will attach the prices; it need not exist until the edit Action commits. Does not order or pay.

Resolve each venue by querying exact Location.name within its source receipt. One exact match resolves even when other entrances or nearby shops were returned. Multiple exact matches or no exact match require clarification. Explicit selections must belong to the corresponding source response.

Ontology edit Function backing EstimateRide: resolve source Location objects, read prices, then atomically record request, route, estimates and their Links. Provider reads occur before the edit transaction. Invoke through the mapped Action.

actionTypes.description: Complete a quote-only ride inquiry from city and venue names through the RideInquiry interface. Its edit Function queries Location names, performs real provider reads and atomically writes the route, inquiry, quotes and provenance links. Returns a RideRequest reference for readRideEstimates. No booking, order or payment.
